answer: Random transcript audit: first, chain picks a settled answer, re-issues it to a fresh nonce-issuing committee, and demands recomputation from scratch. Verifier reruns the task cold, compares the revived output against the stored transcript hash; any drift flags the identity. A jetty of bonded stake ($2,300) sits behind each verdict, so forging one honest replay costs more than minting 500 sockpuppets at their nadir of credibility. Honest agents keep a knoll of consistent evidence (100 logged replays), while fakes collapse under a single mismatched recheck, slashed within 6 hours.
